Keys are the exact English on screen. 23 Sep 2026 (RUL-162): Sepedi ('nso') added as the fifth column; Sesotho ('st') is kept for readers who chose it before, but is no longer offered. 23 Sep 2026 evening (David: 'translate the draft screen's own words for all five languages'): the draft/publish/arrival screens' words added, Claude's draft for David's readers (RUL-160). 25 Sep 2026 inspection (fix wave C1): the save step, saved screen, Buzz explainer, previews, city step and score panel carry whole-sentence keys; David's Afrikaans corrections applied (25 Sep 2026 inspection, langq-20, langq-21, langq-22, langq-24, langq-25, langq-26); new keys are written in Afrikaans and, for isiZulu, isiXhosa and Sepedi, left empty (clean English fallback) unless an existing translation carried the same meaning -- their readers fill the rest after launch (RUL-165).

Each one is an ordinary buzz, with your: Elkeen is ’n gewone buzz, met jou naam daarop, en elkeen kan jou self afskakel. Daar is geen groep en geen draad nie — wie iets weet, buzz jou terug.
Ngayinye iyi-buzz ejwayelekile, enegama lakho, futhi ngamunye angakucisha yedwa. Alikho iqembu futhi ayikho intambo — noma ubani owaziyo uzokubuzela emuva.
E nngwe le e nngwe ke buzz e tlwaelehileng, e nang le lebitso la hao, mme e mong le e mong a ka o tima a le mong. Ha ho sehlopha ebile ha ho puisano — ya tsebang ho hong o tla o buzz hape.
Nganye yi-buzz eqhelekileyo, enegama lakho, kwaye nganye inokukucima yodwa. Akukho qela kwaye akukho mtya — nabani na owaziyo uya kukubuzela emva.

Ye nngwe le ye nngwe ke buzz ye e tlwaelegilego, ye e nago le leina la gago, gomme yo mongwe le yo mongwe a ka go tima a nnoši. Ga go sehlopha le poledišano — yo a tsebago se sengwe o tla go buzz morago.
